verdict.rationale: A probe found a live OpenAPI spec at nethunt.com/api/openapi.json, which is direct evidence that NetHunt publishes a machine-readable public API description. Nothing in the pack shows what that API covers, how it authenticates, or whether it is fully documented, so only the core existence of a documented API is established. The MCP and webhook claims belong to separate stories and are not credited here. Missing for 10: endpoint coverage and read/write scope details, authentication and rate-limit documentation, human-readable API reference docs (docs.md returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the CRM through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
